main.description: Allow the notification server to send push notifications to one of the requesting account's devices. If the server does not yet hold a session for the account, returns the URL to open in a browser to authorize it; the device is allowed once that authorization completes. Otherwise the device is allowed immediately and no URL is returned.

deviceId.description: The device's identifier for vendor, as sent inside the token of app.bsky.notification.registerPush.
